description: Daily (or weekly) water elevation series for a US lake or reservoir over the last 2 to 365 days, from the same government gauge as get_lake_level, one reading per day. Includes first, last, low, high and mean with dates. Use it for trends, drawdown and refill questions.

days.description: Days back from today, 2 to 365. Default 90.

lake.description: Lake slug from search_lakes (for example "lake-mead") or a lake name (for example "Lake Travis").

step.description: daily = one point per day; weekly = every 7th day ending today. Stats always use every day.

name: get_lake_history
title: Get lake level history
